scripts.sync:debug: cp -R dist/* "../src-tauri/target/debug/bundle/macos/Hermes File Manager.app/Contents/Resources/" && cp -p "../src-tauri/target/debug/hermes-file-manager" "../src-tauri/target/debug/bundle/macos/Hermes File Manager.app/Contents/MacOS/hermes-file-manager"
scripts.sync:release: cp -R dist/* "../src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Hermes File Manager.app/Contents/Resources/" && cp -p "../src-tauri/target/release/hermes-file-manager" "../src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Hermes File Manager.app/Contents/MacOS/hermes-file-manager"
scripts.dev:tauri: npm run build && npm run sync:debug && cd ../src-tauri && cargo build && npm run sync:debug
scripts.build:tauri: npm run build && npm run sync:release && cd ../src-tauri && cargo build --release && npm run sync:release
scripts.deploy:debug: npm run sync:debug && rm -rf "/Applications/Hermes File Manager Debug.app" && cp -R "../src-tauri/target/debug/bundle/macos/Hermes File Manager.app" "/Applications/Hermes File Manager Debug.app"
scripts.deploy:release: npm run sync:release && rm -rf "/Applications/Hermes File Manager.app" && cp -R "../src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Hermes File Manager.app" "/Applications/Hermes File Manager.app"
